Agent.//ControlPlaneUri: The control plane (https/wss). F9 uses it for the one-shot enrollment POST; F10 connects the SignalR hub at <uri>/agent/hub. An un-enrolled Agent starts but does not connect.
Agent.//TrustFilePath: Where the enrolled Agent stores its credential (F9). Defaults under %LOCALAPPDATA%/ZWarden/Agent/agent-trust.json.
Agent.//EnrollmentSecret: The one-time enrollment secret (F9). A SECRET: supply via env (Agent__EnrollmentSecret), never commit it. Consumed once on first run.
Agent.//HeartbeatInterval: How often the Agent sends a heartbeat over the control-plane connection (F10). The connection reconnects automatically with a capped backoff.
